Hypothesis ID/version; parent; strategy/model; falsifiable mechanism; target and forecast cost basis; expected failure condition.

Data/universe/feature/label/split IDs; Git SHA; cost/execution/policy versions; authorized train/calibration/validation dates; sealed exposure history; environment/lock/seed.
